items.title: Zoya adds Elvora in Dubai Land Residence Complex
items.summary: Zoya Developments has launched Elvora in DLRC, its latest addition to a portfolio of more than 10 Dubai projects launched in two years. Pricing, unit mix and handover were not disclosed.

items.title: Zoya's Elinor sells out and breaks ground in Dubai South
items.summary: The Dh104 million Elinor project of furnished studios and two-bedroom apartments sold out within two weeks of launch and broke ground less than two months later. Handover is targeted for Q3 2028.
